confidence_notes: Medium overall: holistic estimates from general knowledge; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Cafe, beer and restaurant anchors are most reliable; hostel and hotel rates vary widely in July peak season. Beer assumes a 0.5 L restaurant draft. Cocktail and wine were set from the beer price (cocktail about 2.5x a 0.5 L draft; wine glass about 1.1x) because direct knowledge is weaker. Euro-denominated prices were converted using an approximate market rate, not a checked quote. FX value came from rba.gov.au search results, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Basis is general Central European capital pricing, placing Vienna between Prague (generally lower) and Munich (similar or higher) for restaurant and hotel levels, with a July peak-season premium on accommodation.
